parsed.summary: The PR fixes the alignment issue in HPacker but introduces potential regressions and lacks comprehensive tests.

issues.description: The change may break existing behavior for other alignment options not covered in the PR.
There are no additional tests to verify the fix for different alignment scenarios.
The code change is minimal but could be improved for readability and maintainability.
